title: CardputerAdv
summary: Run Cardputer-Adv firmware locally with keyboard, audio and saved flash.
description: An experimental native Cardputer-Adv firmware emulator for the CardputerZero LCD. Includes the official M5Stack UserDemo, Wordle and UIFlow2 images with their license notices, persistent local flash, firmware cache and APPLaunch shortcuts. Optional network access browses and downloads the official firmware library. Use F/X to select, Enter to run, short Esc to pause or go back, and hold Esc to exit. Accurate mode is substantially slower than the real device. FAST is an explicit timing approximation for menus and games; it disables live microphone input and physical HAT I/O. Hardware support is partial: selected I2C/SPI/GPIO bridges and local audio are implemented, IMU is modeled, and UART, microSD, IR and radio bridges are unavailable. Firmware compatibility and audio/microphone behavior vary; this release does not promise real-time execution or full hardware compatibility.
